identification: English oak smokers/tobacco cabinet c1900-1925, about 27 x 25 x 20 cm: shaped glazed door with key escutcheon, plated knob, one drawer, pipe-rack slots inside, holding a brown and grey marbled stoneware tobacco jar with lid, plus a cigar cutter and a small round black box (ashtray/pot). Jar is unmarked in the photos (Doulton Lambeth, Denby or Bourne style); not seen on its base. Glass door pane looks present; a paper tag hangs from the door.

viewing_check: Glass pane present and uncracked, hinge and lock work, key present, drawer runs, pipe-rack slots intact, veneer lifting, woodworm; turn the jar over for a maker's mark (Doulton Lambeth / Denby / Bourne) and check it has no chips and the lid fits.
